gloss: pi; ratio of circumference to diameter

definitions.gloss: pi (π); ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter
definitions.explanation: The mathematical constant pi (π), approximately 3.14159, representing the ratio of any circle's circumference to its diameter.

examples.japanese: {円周率|えんしゅうりつ}は{約|やく}3.14だ。
{円周率|えんしゅうりつ}を100{桁|けた}まで{覚|おぼ}えている。
examples.english: I have memorized pi to 100 digits.

examples.japanese: {円|えん}の{面積|めんせき}は{半径|はんけい}の{二乗|にじょう}に{円周率|えんしゅうりつ}をかけて{求|もと}める。
examples.english: The area of a circle is found by multiplying the square of the radius by pi.

notes:
Composed of {円|えん} (circle) + {周|しゅう} (circumference) + {率|りつ} (ratio). The Greek letter π is read パイ in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円周率|えんしゅうりつ}を{使|つか}う: to use pi
- {円周率|えんしゅうりつ}の{近似値|きんじち}: an approximate value of pi
- {円周率|えんしゅうりつ}を{覚|おぼ}える: to memorize pi

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
Japanese students typically learn 3.14 as a working value. March 14 (3/14) is celebrated as {円周率|えんしゅうりつ}の{日|ひ} (Pi Day).
